meta.name: meta-ad-scraper
meta.description: Scrape competitor ads from Meta's Ad Library (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, Threads, WhatsApp). Search by company name, Facebook Page URL, or keyword. Returns ad creatives, spend estimates, reach, impressions, and campaign details. Use for competitive ad research, messaging analysis, and creative inspiration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 抓取竞品广告创意与投放数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做竞品广告调研或获取创意灵感。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape competitor ad creatives and campaign data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to research competitor ads or get creative inspiration.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索 Meta 广告库（Facebook、Instagram 等），获取竞争对手的广告文案、图片、视频、花费估算、覆盖人数和展示次数等信息。
howto.when: 当你要求分析竞争对手广告、研究行业广告趋势，或提供公司名称、关键词或 Facebook 页面链接时触发。

say.text: 搜索 Nike 在 Facebook 上的广告。
say.note: 返回 Nike 当前活跃的广告列表。

say.text: 比较 Shopify 和 Stripe 的广告策略。
say.note: 分别搜索两家公司的广告，对比创意和花费。

say.text: 查找关键词“CRM 软件”的广告。
say.note: 返回所有投放 CRM 软件广告的广告主。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search Meta's Ad Library (Facebook, Instagram, etc.) to retrieve competitor ads including ad copy, images, videos, spend estimates, reach, and impressions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze competitor ads, research industry ad trends, or provide a company name, keyword, or Facebook Page URL.

say_en.text: Search for Nike's ads on Facebook.
Compare ad strategies of Shopify and Stripe.
say_en.note: Searches ads for both companies and compares creatives and spend.
Returns all advertisers running CRM software ads.
